clauses.statement: Directory walkers on the diagnosis evidence path (architecture-profiler, network-contract-scanner, database-access-scanner, code-quality-scanner, static-site-scanner, component-style-scanner, flow-design-scanner, gesture-interaction-scanner) must traverse iteratively with an explicit pending queue and a single result accumulator; no walker may recurse per directory or pass an accumulated subtree result as spread call arguments, so the result size never enters a call's argument list.
clauses.rationale: files.push(...await collectFiles(...)) passes every accumulated entry as call arguments; with ~127k files under one subtree this exceeds V8's stack-proportional argument limit and throws 'Maximum call stack size exceeded', killing story diagnose on large repositories.
